name: Netflix

changelog: Latest update for the best experience with recent hits and classics on phones and tablets.

summary: The Netflix APK is the official Android app for streaming Netflix series, films, documentaries, live events and games. Google Play updated it on November 24, 2026, and the version varies by device. The app is free to install, but watching needs a paid Netflix membership.
metaDescription: Netflix APK download for Android: get the official Netflix app from Google Play, with plans, offline downloads, kids profiles and fixes for common errors.

faq.q: Can I download Netflix movies on Android?
faq.a: Yes, on most plans. Tap the download button on a supported title, and watch it offline later. Downloads expire after a set time, and some titles can't be downloaded.
Yes, with a Kids profile. Kids profiles show only titles for the age rating you choose, and you can add a PIN to your own profile so children can't switch to it.

faq.q: Why is Netflix not working on my TV?
faq.a: Restart the TV, update its Netflix app and check your connection. If Netflix works on your phone but not the TV, sign out of Netflix on the TV and back in.
The app is free to install, but you need a paid membership to watch. Plans and prices depend on your country, and some countries have a cheaper plan with ads.
